statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r is the maximum of the set { values[i] + values[j] + i - j | 0 <= i < j < len(values) }. Equivalently, for every i and j with 0 <= i < j < len(values), values[i] + values[j] + i - j <= r, and there exist i and j with 0 <= i < j < len(values) such that values[i] + values[j] + i - j = r.
preconditions: len(values) >= 2 and len(values) <= 50000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(values), 1 <= values[i] <= 1000. All indices are 0-based.

statement: The function returns a result r for every input satisfying the preconditions; it does not panic, access out of bounds, or overflow.
preconditions: len(values) >= 2 and len(values) <= 50000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(values), 1 <= values[i] <= 1000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, for every i and j with 0 <= i < j < len(values), values[i] + values[j] + i - j <= r.
preconditions: len(values) >= 2 and len(values) <= 50000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(values), 1 <= values[i] <= 1000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, there exist indices i and j with 0 <= i < j < len(values) such that r = values[i] + values[j] + i - j.
preconditions: len(values) >= 2 and len(values) <= 50000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(values), 1 <= values[i] <= 1000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r is the least integer upper bound on the set of pair scores: for every i and j with 0 <= i < j < len(values), values[i] + values[j] + i - j <= r; and for every integer B, if values[i] + values[j] + i - j <= B for every i and j with 0 <= i < j < len(values), then r <= B.
preconditions: len(values) >= 2 and len(values) <= 50000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(values), 1 <= values[i] <= 1000. All indices are 0-based.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r <= 2 * M - 1, where M = max { values[i] | 0 <= i < len(values) }.
preconditions: len(values) >= 2 and len(values) <= 50000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(values), 1 <= values[i] <= 1000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r = values[0] + values[1] - 1.
Whenever the function returns a result r, r = values[len(values)-2] + values[len(values)-1] - 1.
preconditions: len(values) >= 2 and len(values) <= 50000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(values), 1 <= values[i] <= 1000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(values) - 1, values[i] <= values[i+1].

statement: For every array values satisfying the preconditions, define rev by len(rev) = len(values) and rev[k] = values[len(values)-1-k] for every k with 0 <= k < len(values). If the function returns r on values and returns r_rev on rev, then r_rev = r.
preconditions: len(values) >= 2 and len(values) <= 50000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(values), 1 <= values[i] <= 1000.

statement: Define shifted by len(shifted) = len(values) and shifted[i] = values[i] + c for every i with 0 <= i < len(values). If the function returns r on values and returns r_c on shifted, then r_c = r + 2*c.
preconditions: len(values) >= 2 and len(values) <= 50000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(values), 1 <= values[i] <= 1000. Also c is an integer such that for every i with 0 <= i < len(values), 1 <= values[i] + c <= 1000.
